decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-688 MODIFY establishing that processRandomReferral credits the selected token ID with the $5 commission; the first-mint exception was already established at message 684.

The candidate already has a message-688 MODIFY establishing that processRandomReferral credits the selected token ID with one Small Block ticket; the first-mint exception was already established at message 684.

The existing message-688 MODIFY already captures crediting code-used tickets to the referrer's token ID and no-code tickets to the randomly selected token ID, together with the accepted first-mint accounting exception.

The source clarifies no-referral reward allocation, not the method, provider, weighting, or population used for prize-winner selection; randomly assigned ticket holders are already included in the eligible population.
Changing the FAQ's no-referral edge-case explanation does not necessarily require the independently maintained About page to add or revise corresponding copy.

The candidate already requires randomly assigned no-referral commissions to be registered and shown on all relevant surfaces. The selected-token allocation detail is owned by the dedicated allocation requirement, while the message's observed attribute mismatch is execution evidence rather than a propagated MODIFY.
The candidate already specifies one Small Block ticket credited to the referrer's NFT for a valid code-used mint; the source does not change that code-used issuance rule.

The candidate already requires tickets and commissions from both code-used and no-referral allocations to appear in NFT attributes. Message 688's stale-attribute observation is already represented as a runtime failure and does not entail a new value change.
The source changes a detailed FAQ explanation and does not require the landing-page mechanics summary to include the no-referral first-mint exception.
The no-referral recipient and first-mint exception do not change the $15 mint price, the $5 commission allocation amount, the founder share, or the Small Block pool share.
The FAQ edge-case clarification does not necessarily alter the Mission page's high-level description of referral rewards and prize mechanics.

The source does not change which referral codes are valid or the approved feedback for ordinary blank or invalid codes. The first-mint exception was accepted as a completed one-off with no forward impact and does not supply replacement popup copy.
